english.note: Use this for the literary or artistic technique of giving an object or idea human qualities, rather than for the resulting figure itself.

examples.english: This poem uses personification to make the moon seem able to speak to people.
examples.traditional: 呢首詩運用擬人法，令月亮好似識得同人講嘢咁。
